title.narrative: ISF LATIN AMERICA (PANAMA): BUILDING CAPACITY TO MONITOR & REGULATE JUDICIAL & CRIMINAL JUSTICE ACTOR PERFORMANCE

description.narrative: 3.4.1 Assist the Judicial College in reviewing and reforming its internal processes for the analysis of performance data collected from those who use its services; 3.4.2 Design new pathways towards an improved and more efficient training offer from the Judicial College, particularly reviewing centralized data review processes as well as streamlining the current training offer; 3.4.3 Assist the Judicial College in reforming its processes to better identify and address poor performance by the criminal justice actors it superintends; 3.4.4 Ensure link-up of the above work with any other relevant initiatives being developed by other training bodies or regulators of criminal justice performance in Panama or the broader Latin American region. 3.4.5 Such other support to the performance of Panama's – or the region’s – criminal justice and regulatory systems as aligns with the CIEP's theory of change and is agreed between the Authority and the Supplier.

This project supports the Panamanian Judicial College in improving its ability to monitor, evaluate, and regulate the performance of criminal justice actors in Panama. ASI works closely with the College, using adaptive programming to help reform internal processes, enhance training delivery, and address poor performance, while aligning efforts with other regional initiatives. The project contributes to broader UK efforts in Latin America under the Combatting Illicit Economies Programme.
